features.note: Facade carries a generated red marquee band and a 'Cinemex' word sign with no protected art; corridor shows numbered room plaques 1..8, EXIT signs, extinguisher panels, green floor evacuation arrows and generated abstract poster blocks. The 60x45 band/spine/room grammar survives every surface preset.

sala-3 shows abstract generated screen content (visibly different frame 0 vs frame 1), yellow aisle marks and patterned dark carpet. Acoustic panel rhythm is thin and irregular (a few isolated strips) and the side walls read bright white rather than absorptive, so meso detail is only marginally above bar.

Lobby/concessions/kitchen presets now show real fit-out, not a roof slab: ticket counter with lit POS faces, kiosk stack, wall menu boards with generated menu strips, concession counter with POS terminals and menu headers, kitchen worktop with cabinets, popcorn unit and a hood/duct stack. Snack-machine and refrigeration cues are still sparse and the kitchen workline is barely framed.

Diagram board is finally correct: BUS A/B/C/D boxes (5+4+4+1 = 14 TC300) -> arrowed green 'RS-485 / MODBUS RTU' edges -> UC100-A..D -> four arrowed blue dashed LoRaWAN edges landing on four labelled RF1..RF4 ports -> UG67-01 -> arrowed blue Ethernet down to ROUTER/FIREWALL -> arrow -> INTERNET -> explicit arrow -> NIAGARA SUPERVISOR -> three arrowed edges into PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE. Every caption sits inside its box, legend present, no shortcut edge, and 'UG67-01 - UBICACION REAL / VINCULO AL MODELO' plus a cyan leader ties the board to the real gateway instead of replacing it. The MODEL side fails the first hop: RS-485 drops in the corridor terminate on bare olive junction stubs with no TC300 device body, no black/blue ring marker and no ID sprite at ANY of the seven surface presets (labels=on), so TC300 -> RS-485 is only legible on the board. Secondary: in complete-network the board slab occludes the building's east third and hides the UG67 -> router Ethernet run; LoRaWAN dashes and Ethernet run render as near-identical pale-blue chunky bars, weakening the dashed/solid media distinction at distance.

Architecture presets are opaque and technical labels are suppressed (no UC/UG67/TC sprites anywhere in the arch set); engineering presets show translucent shell, green trunks, dashed links, zone tint and UC-A..D / UG67 label chips. Small state leak: faint cyan RF tick marks still render around the UG67 in state=architecture, where network is specified hidden.

important_features.note: 1.8 m people, 2.1 m doors and a correctly tiny wall-mounted UG67 with two vertical antennas read right. But the architecture diagram board is a building-scale slab dominating the site, and the LoRaWAN/Ethernet 'dashes' are ~2 m chunky bars - media geometry is inflated relative to the devices it describes.

Scored only on surface-owned emission cues: marquee, menu boards, POS faces and screen content are emissive and readable; corridor exit signage reads. Auditorium walls stay bright white so the dark-room hierarchy is not yet established (much of this is lighting-camera's to fix).

RS-485 trunks run in visible containment with junction boxes, right-angle drops and yellow direction cones; the kitchen hood/duct stack is present. Deduction: drops end on stubs with nothing attached, so containment terminates on air.

defects: eng-corridor (and every other surface preset): RS-485 drop tubes descend to a small olive junction cube and stop. No TC300 body, no dark-glass face with blue status ring, and no 'TC300-xx' label sprite is visible anywhere in the seven-view surface set even with labels=on - the canonical chain's first node exists only on the diagram board.

eng-complete-network: the architecture board slab is planted between the building and the external schematic; it occludes roughly the east third of the shell and completely hides the UG67 -> ROUTER/FIREWALL Ethernet run, which is the only edge the model has to prove the IP hop.

eng-complete-network / eng-ug67: LoRaWAN links and the Ethernet run are both drawn as pale-blue chunky bars of similar size; at preset distance the dashed-vs-solid media distinction collapses and the LoRaWAN dashes read as anonymous floating slabs (they are also visually confusable with the pale-blue ceiling strips in eng-corridor).
eng views: RS-485 trunks render as pale mint/near-white tubes rather than the specified saturated green (#29d67d), so the green-solid media class is weak against the light translucent shell.
arch-frame0/1-ug67: faint cyan RF tick marks remain visible around the UG67 in state=architecture, where visual_states.architecture declares network hidden.
network-schematic-detail: the 'GATEWAY' subtitle inside the UG67-01 box overlaps the RF2 port caption.
arch-frame0/1-facade: the generated poster bank sits at the right frame edge and is half cropped; only two of its panels are legible in the facade preset that is supposed to be its evidence view.

arch-frame0-concessions: the concession bar is a bare slab counter with POS faces and menu headers only - no popcorn/refrigeration/snack-display cues, so the 'dominant concession bar' reads as a ticket desk clone.
arch-frame0-lobby: the left half of the frame is a blank gray wall; the lobby fit-out it is meant to evidence is squeezed into the right third.
corrections: Render the 14 TC300 endpoints as real surface devices at the end of each RS-485 drop: dark-glass face, blue status ring, and a distance-culled 'TC300-01'..'TC300-14' ID sprite that is visible in state=engineering&labels=on at the corridor, kitchen, lobby, sala-3 and complete-network presets. Do not enlarge the device body - carry the readability in the label chip and the ring, exactly as the UC100/UG67 chips already do.
Add a terminal cue at each drop-to-TC300 junction (the drop must visibly land ON the device face, not on a bare junction cube).

Move the architecture diagram board out of the UG67 -> router sightline (e.g. behind the external schematic at +z, or rotate it to face the complete-network camera from the far side) so the whole Ethernet run from the real UG67 to ROUTER/FIREWALL is unobstructed and the shell is no longer occluded in eng-complete-network.

Differentiate LoRaWAN from Ethernet in the model: shrink the LoRaWAN dash segments and their gaps so they read as a dashed RF path, keep the Ethernet run a continuous tube, and raise the color separation between the two blue classes.
Restore the specified RS-485 green (#29d67d) on trunks and drops so they stay saturated against the 0.18-opacity shell instead of washing out to mint.
Suppress the UG67 RF tick marks in state=architecture so the architecture/engineering state pair stays clean.
Nudge the 'GATEWAY' subtitle up inside the UG67-01 box on the diagram board so it stops overlapping the RF2 caption.
Reframe the facade preset (or shift the poster bank inboard) so the full generated poster bank is inside frame in both poster_frame=0 and poster_frame=1.
Add snack/popcorn/refrigeration display cues along the concession counter and recenter the lobby preset on the ticketing/kiosk cluster instead of the blank west wall.

mechanical.note: probe 198 draws / 37042 tris vs 550/750000; 23/23 console sidecars clean; 114 unit tests pass
